name: Two-Universes Rupture

success: S1: a precisely characterized, replicable law holding in BOTH

stats.note: Every square/dot particle is data-backed by one integer prime or one sampled irreducible polynomial. Lines, glow, and the central ribbon are structural overlays, not counted particles.
